# Verification — T-NNN

- Date / tester role and agent/session:
- Exact commit / dirty patch reference:
- macOS version / CPU architecture / build profile:
- Device / firmware / connection mode:
- Sample rate / buffer frames / actual output channels:
- Fixture origin / license / checksum:

| Check / criterion | Exact command or manual procedure | Expected result / tolerance | Actual result | PASS / FAIL / NOT RUN | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Example | Replace with reproducible steps | Specify before test | Record measurement | NOT RUN | Reason / unblock owner |

## Audio measurement details

Record duration, workload, callback maximum and percentile durations, xrun counter source, audible glitch observations and load conditions. Callback duration is not round-trip latency. For latency, document the loopback method and measured distribution separately.

## Hardware scenarios

Cover independent cue/master output, transport, jog modes, pitch/EQ/faders, LED feedback, disconnect/reconnect, rate changes and sleep/wake as applicable. Simulation evidence stays labeled simulated.

## Findings and review

Reproduction and severity for failures; coverage gaps; reviewer identity; integrated revision if different. Never convert NOT RUN into PASS to close a milestone.
